title: ReceiptSorter — Offline-First Vision Receipt & Invoice Ledger
tagline: Private, offline expense management powered by local open-weight vision models and SQLite.
problem: Freelancers and small businesses need to extract receipt and invoice data without uploading sensitive financial documents to third-party cloud APIs or incurring expensive recurring vision model API subscriptions.
outcome: Engineered a 100% offline-first application that extracts vendor, date, line items, taxes, and totals locally, indexing all records into a local SQLite ledger with multi-format export.
description: A privacy-first receipt and invoice processing application utilizing local open-weight vision models. Upload receipt photos or invoice scans, and the engine extracts structured metadata into a card review interface, persistent SQLite ledger, and visual analytics with zero cloud calls.
highlights: Engineered local vision inference pipeline running 100% on-device with zero cloud calls or API dependencies
Built persistent SQLite ledger with automated categorization, tax calculation, and multi-format report exports
Designed interactive review UI for rapid verification and inline correction of parsed receipt line items

images.alt: ReceiptSorter local vision extraction and SQLite ledger telemetry

title: Sign Language Interpreter — Real-Time ASL to Voice Engine
tagline: Real-time computer vision system translating ASL hand gestures into spoken voice on-device.
problem: Sign language translation tools often suffer from high cloud latency, require specialized sensory hardware, or compromise user privacy by streaming continuous video to external servers.
outcome: Developed an accessible, browser-native ASL interpreter that translates webcam video into live captions and synthesized speech at 30-60 FPS with sub-20ms latency directly on client hardware.
description: An accessibility-first computer vision system that translates American Sign Language (ASL) gestures into real-time captions and natural spoken voice. The entire pipeline executes locally in the browser over WebAssembly and WebGL with zero cloud GPU streaming.
highlights: Achieved ~12ms on-device inference using browser-native WebAssembly and WebGL execution
Integrated Web Speech Synthesis API for instantaneous voice translation synchronized with gesture detection
Engineered continuous landmark tracking pipeline maintaining high accuracy under varying webcam lighting

title: The Crochet Diaryy — Modern Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform
tagline: Full-stack e-commerce store with NextAuth credentials, Prisma ORM, and Razorpay checkout.
problem: Independent artisan businesses struggle with clunky e-commerce platforms that lack smooth custom design, persistent responsive carts, and clean automated payment reconciliation.
outcome: Architected and deployed a production-ready e-commerce platform featuring Next.js 15 App Router, Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, NextAuth.js v5, and native Razorpay payment gateway integration.
description: A modern e-commerce web platform engineered for The Crochet Diaryy. Features an optimized shopping experience with persistent Zustand cart state, authenticated customer dashboards, automated order emails via Resend, and Razorpay transactions.
highlights: Built scalable Next.js 15 App Router architecture with Tailwind CSS v4 and responsive product catalogs
Integrated PostgreSQL database via Prisma ORM for inventory management and order fulfillment tracking
Implemented secure NextAuth.js v5 authentication and seamless Razorpay payment gateway checkout

title: Moon Sweepers — Tactical Automation & Incremental Game
tagline: Tactile incremental cleaning & automation mobile game built in Godot 4 / GDScript.
problem: Mobile games often rely on predatory mechanics and bloated engines rather than clean, tactile physics and responsive state management.
outcome: Engineered an incremental cleaning and factory automation mobile game in Godot 4 with customized regolith gathering physics, modular upgrades, and responsive touch controls.
description: A tactile incremental game built in Godot 4 for mobile devices. Features state-driven factory automation, asteroid regolith compression pipelines, and custom physics simulation.
highlights: Implemented custom incremental economy and automation logic in GDScript with zero frame drops
Designed one-finger touch gesture interaction model for smooth mobile gameplay
Architected modular upgrade trees and persistent local save state serialization

title: Lunexa — Peer-to-Peer Smart Learning Platform
tagline: Interactive collaborative learning web platform with clean responsive architecture.
problem: Students require clean, distraction-free study environments that facilitate peer exchange and structured subject indexing.
outcome: Built a lightweight peer-to-peer learning platform with responsive layout, semantic navigation, and multi-device optimization.
description: A collaborative educational web platform facilitating peer-to-peer knowledge sharing, study scheduling, and learning material curation.
highlights: Engineered responsive, accessible UI with zero layout shifts and optimized asset loading
Implemented client-side search and tag-based filtering for instant resource retrieval
Structured modular architecture allowing seamless cloud deployment on Netlify and Vercel
